responsibility: This file implements array lowering from gfortran expressions to GCC trees, including the scalarizer and array-descriptor support. It walks array expressions into gfc_ss chains, computes loop bounds/strides and descriptor accesses, resolves assignment dependencies and temporary needs, creates and copies temporary/allocatable arrays, handles elemental and intrinsic array arguments, builds CFI and native descriptor field accesses, and emits the loop-based GENERIC code for array references, array parameters, constructors, and reallocatable-lhs behavior.
same_name_distinction: Implements array-specific lowering behavior, especially scalarization walks, descriptor/CFI field access, loop setup, temporaries, and array-expression translation. Unlike gcc/fortran/trans-array.h, it contains the operational array-lowering logic rather than the cross-file declarations of that interface.
